abstract: We develop a two-country trade model with sequential production in which a technologically backward economy exports intermediates in exchange for final goods from a technologically advanced economy. The advanced country can raise welfare by imposing import tariffs on intermediates, whereas export tariffs on intermediates or import tariffs on final goods are ineffective for the backward economy. Instead, the backward economy resorts to a quantitative export constraint, diverting part of its labor force into a less efficient autarkic production process. We show that non-cooperative policy choices reduce trade and lower welfare in both countries, underscoring the need for a trade agreement. To sustain mutually beneficial liberalization after prior tariff reductions, however, an agreement may have to link tariff cuts to the removal of export constraints, particularly when lifting these constraints is costly for the backward economy.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个包含序贯生产的两国贸易模型，其中技术落后的经济体出口中间品，以换取技术先进经济体的最终产品。先进国家可以通过对中间品征收进口关税来提高福利，而对落后经济体而言，对中间品征收出口关税或对最终产品征收进口关税则无效。相反，落后经济体转而采取数量性出口限制，将部分劳动力转移至效率较低的封闭式生产过程中。我们证明，非合作的政策选择会减少贸易并降低两国福利，凸显了贸易协定的必要性。然而，在先前关税削减之后，为维持互利的自由化，协定可能必须将关税削减与取消出口限制挂钩，尤其是在解除这些限制对落后经济体而言成本高昂的情况下。
title: Trade policy in a model of sequential production
title_zh: 序贯生产模型中的贸易政策

abstract: Local governments promise democratic responsiveness but are also vulnerable to political capture by illicit actors. While existing research documents the political and economic consequences of capture, less is known about how bureaucrats respond when political leadership is captured - whether they become instruments of corrupt rule or resist it. We examine these competing expectations in the context of Italian municipalities infiltrated by mafia organizations. Leveraging a law that allows the central government to dissolve captured municipal councils, we study how bureaucratic performance responds when political capture is abruptly removed. Using a difference-in-differences design with matched controls based on a machine-learning index of mafia-infiltration risk, we show that dissolutions substantially improve bureaucratic performance. Evidence from administrative data and investigative reports supports the interpretation that the lower performance during mafia rule was driven by bureaucrats resisting political capture. Our findings show that bureaucracies mitigate, rather than amplify, the downstream consequences of political capture.
abstract_zh: 地方政府承诺民主回应性，但也易受非法行为者的政治俘获。尽管现有研究记录了俘获的政治与经济后果，但对于政治领导层被俘获时官僚如何应对——他们是沦为腐败统治的工具，还是予以抵制——知之甚少。我们在意大利被黑手党组织渗透的市镇背景下考察了这些相互竞争的预期。利用一项允许中央政府解散被俘获市议会的法律，我们研究了当政治俘获被突然移除时官僚绩效如何响应。基于黑手党渗透风险的机器学习指数匹配对照组，采用双重差分设计，我们表明解散显著改善了官僚绩效。来自行政数据和调查报告的证据支持这样一种解释，即黑手党统治期间较低的绩效是由官僚抵制政治俘获所驱动的。我们的发现表明，官僚机构缓解而非放大了政治俘获的下游后果。
title: Political Capture and Bureaucratic Behavior. Evidence from Mafia-Infiltrated Municipalities
title_zh: 政治俘获与官僚行为：来自黑手党渗透市镇的证据

abstract: Employing the quasi‐natural experiment of the emission reduction targets of the 11th Five‐Year Plan in 2006, this study investigates the impact of environmental regulation on FDI stocks and flows in China. We find that stringent environmental regulations lead to a “shift” of FDI to less regulated regions due to the “rising cost effect” and “innovation compensation effect”. The effect is prominent for firms with a high capital‐labor ratio, that are state‐owned, in non‐high‐tech or pollution‐intensive sectors. An examination of FDI flows indicates that the observed redirection of FDI is largely driven by foreign investors favouring regions with lenient environmental regulations. Further investigation focusing on parent‐subsidiary relationships reveals that environmental regulations lead to a decrease in the number of subsidiaries established locally by enterprises in regions with stringent regulations. Subsidiaries receive more FDI when the gap in environmental regulation intensity between the location of the parent enterprises and the location of the subsidiaries is larger.
abstract_zh: 本研究以2006年“十一五”规划减排目标为准自然实验，探讨环境规制对中国外商直接投资存量与流量的影响。研究发现，严格的环境规制因“成本上升效应”与“创新补偿效应”导致外商直接投资向规制较宽松地区“转移”。这一效应在资本劳动比高、国有、非高技术或污染密集型行业的企业中尤为显著。对FDI流量的分析表明，观察到的FDI转向主要由外国投资者偏好环境规制宽松地区所驱动。进一步聚焦母子公司关系的研究揭示，环境规制导致规制严格地区企业在本土设立的子公司数量减少。当母公司所在地与子公司所在地的环境规制强度差距越大时，子公司获得的外商直接投资越多。

title: The Effects of Environmental Regulation on FDI: New Evidence From Inward FDI Flows in China
title_zh: 环境规制对外商直接投资的影响：来自中国内向FDI流入的新证据

abstract: This paper examines how tariffs and non‐tariff measures (NTMs) imposed by Brazil's major agricultural trading partners affect the country's exports at the country–product level over the period 2000–2017. Using a newly assembled dataset of NTMs from the TRAINS database and a novel methodology for constructing unilateral trade flows in a single‐exporter setting, we estimate a reduced‐form Poisson pseudo‐maximum likelihood (PPML) model. The results show that tariffs exert large and consistently negative effects on export performance, while NTMs have heterogeneous impacts that depend on their economic characteristics and on the treatment of Brazilian products relative to competing exporters. We also introduce a measure of the cumulative trade frictions arising from the joint application of tariffs and NTMs, showing that multilateral NTMs substantially amplify the trade‐reducing effects of tariffs, particularly for price and quantity measures. Finally, an event‐study analysis based on the Local Projections Difference‐in‐Differences (LP‐DiD) estimator indicates that the introduction of a new NTM temporarily reduces the export share of the affected product, with recovery beginning in the third year after implementation.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了巴西主要农业贸易伙伴实施的关税与非关税措施（NTMs）如何影响该国在2000年至2017年间国家-产品层面的出口。利用从TRAINS数据库新汇编的非关税措施数据集，以及一种在单一出口国情境下构建单边贸易流的新方法，我们估计了一个简化形式的泊松伪最大似然（PPML）模型。结果表明，关税对出口绩效产生了显著且持续的负面影响，而非关税措施的影响则具有异质性，取决于其经济特征以及巴西产品相对于竞争出口国的待遇。我们还引入了一种衡量关税与非关税措施联合应用所产生的累积贸易摩擦的指标，显示多边非关税措施显著放大了关税的贸易缩减效应，尤其是对价格和数量措施而言。最后，基于局部投影双重差分（LP-DiD）估计量的事件研究分析表明，新非关税措施的引入会暂时降低受影响产品的出口份额，并在实施后第三年开始恢复。
title: Modelling the Effects of Tariffs and Non‐Tariff Measures on Agricultural Products: Evidence From a Developing Country
title_zh: 关税与非关税措施对农产品影响的建模：来自发展中国家的证据

abstract: Rapid urbanization is reshaping landscapes worldwide, concentrating populations and economic activities while intensifying environmental challenges. Understanding the long-term impacts of three-dimensional (3-D) urban expansion on the thermal environment is essential for advancing the United Nations’ Sustainable Development Goals and mitigating climate change. While the urban heat island (UHI) effect has been extensively studied, most research has overlooked how regional-scale long-term thermal dynamics evolve under sustained 3-D urban expansion. Previous studies have largely focused on single or several cities in short time periods, leaving the long-term regional consequences of 3-D expansion poorly understood. Here, we examined the Yangtze River Delta (YRD) region from 2000 to 2020 to assess how long-term 3-D (horizontal and vertical) urban expansion shapes land surface temperature (LST) and surface urban heat island intensity (SUHII). During this period, impervious surface area (ISA) increased from 16493.90 km² to 51738.24 km², while mean building height (BH) showed a slight overall increase, indicating the coexistence of rapid horizontal expansion and moderate vertical urban growth. Both annual mean LST and SUHII show a fluctuating but overall upward trend during daytime and nighttime. In a 3-D context, LST and SUHII were positively correlated with impervious surface coverage (ISC) and BH. Notably, when the horizontal urban intensity gradient was in the range of 0–0.4, the value of LST was relatively low. The increase in SUHII along the horizontal urban intensity gradient at nighttime was smaller than at daytime, and there was an obvious inflection point (ISC = 0.8). In addition, when the vertical urban intensity gradient ranged from 20 to 30 m, it had the most unfavorable impact on the thermal environment of the YRD region. These findings provide novel insights into the long-term thermal impacts of 3-D urban expansion. They highlight critical thresholds of urban form that exacerbate heat stress, offering valuable implications for formulating effective urban heat adaptation policies in rapidly urbanizing regions.
abstract_zh: 快速城市化正在重塑全球景观，集中人口和经济活动，同时加剧环境挑战。理解三维（3-D）城市扩张对热环境的长期影响，对于推进联合国可持续发展目标和减缓气候变化至关重要。尽管城市热岛（UHI）效应已被广泛研究，但大多数研究忽视了在持续的三维城市扩张下，区域尺度的长期热动态如何演变。以往研究多聚焦于单个或少数城市在短时间内的变化，导致对三维扩张的长期区域后果认识不足。本研究以2000年至2020年的长江三角洲（YRD）地区为例，评估长期三维（水平和垂直）城市扩张如何塑造地表温度（LST）和地表城市热岛强度（SUHII）。在此期间，不透水表面面积（ISA）从16493.90平方公里增加到51738.24平方公里，而平均建筑高度（BH）总体略有上升，表明快速水平扩张与适度垂直城市增长并存。年际平均LST和SUHII在白天和夜间均呈现波动但总体上升的趋势。在三维背景下，LST和SUHII与不透水表面覆盖率（ISC）和BH呈正相关。值得注意的是，当水平城市强度梯度在0–0.4范围内时，LST值相对较低。夜间沿水平城市强度梯度的SUHII增幅小于白天，并存在明显的拐点（ISC = 0.8）。此外，当垂直城市强度梯度在20至30米范围内时，对长三角地区热环境的不利影响最为显著。这些发现为三维城市扩张的长期热影响提供了新颖见解，揭示了加剧热应激的城市形态关键阈值，为快速城市化地区制定有效的城市热适应政策提供了宝贵启示。

abstract: Central banks lean on communication to anchor inflation expectations. But most households learn about the economy from the news rather than from policy statements, and in polarised societies, different outlets cover the same inflation very differently. Drawing on household panel data, television transcripts, and a randomised experiment in Turkey, this column shows that heavier inflation coverage on a viewer’s preferred channel raises their inflation expectations, an effect driven almost entirely by viewers of politically neutral channels. Partisan audiences barely respond, updating only to sources they already trust. Political segmentation of the media can therefore erode the common information base on which anchored expectations depend.
abstract_zh: 中央银行倚重沟通来锚定通胀预期。然而，多数家庭是从新闻而非政策声明中了解经济状况，在极化社会中，不同媒体对同一通胀现象的报道方式大相径庭。基于家庭面板数据、电视节目文稿及在土耳其进行的一项随机实验，本专栏指出，观众偏好频道对通胀报道的增多会推高其通胀预期，这一效应几乎完全由观看政治中立频道的观众驱动。党派倾向的观众反应甚微，仅会依据其已信任的信息源进行调整。因此，媒体的政治分化可能侵蚀锚定预期所依赖的共同信息基础。
authors: Selva Demiralp, Orkun Saka, Michael Weber
title: When the news you watch shapes the inflation you expect
title_zh: 你所观看的新闻如何塑造你预期的通胀
